metadata.description: Step2 ordering: all Service Group memberships complete before goal assignment and the independent Usage Plan, Enrollment, Recovery Plan, and Drill dependency chain.

Name of the already-existing Service Group (created by step1) to assign a resilience goal to. Default matches step1's default naming formula so both templates chain together in the same resource group with no parameters.
Name of the goal assignment. Only one goalAssignment is allowed per Service Group.
Only 'Resiliency' is accepted.

No separate goalTemplates resource is needed on this apiVersion or later. A standalone goalTemplates resource's write is hard-blocked (DisallowedResourceOperation) on every apiVersion - do not add one. goalTemplateId instead points at the Service Group's own resource ID. Do not set requireZonalResiliency explicitly - both true and false are currently rejected (RHUBUserErrorInvalidRequestParameter); omitting it yields the only supported default (true).
Name of the Standard Usage Plan (RG + subscription scoped).
Name of the enrollment child resource binding the Service Group to the Usage Plan.

zonalRecoveryPlanDescription.defaultValue: Zonal recovery plan for Service Group

metadata.description: apiVersion for usagePlans/enrollments/recoveryPlans. A Usage Plan + Enrollment must exist before a recoveryPlans resource can be created against the Service Group (RHBLUserErrorNotEnrolled otherwise).
Name of the Drill. Pattern: letters, numbers, hyphens only, 3-24 chars.
Region where the Drill's internal (Chaos/monitoring) resources are created. Must match an allowed region; hardcoded here like the IRM resource group.

2026-10-01 (GA) or 2026-09-30-preview. Do NOT use 2026-08-31-preview: its swagger declares healthModelMonitoringProperties.discoveryRuleId as the required field, but the backend actually serializes/expects healthModelId - causing GET to fail with HttpResponsePayloadAPISpecValidationFailed on that apiVersion once healthModelMonitoringProperties is set. The field is healthModelMonitoringProperties.healthModelId (the Health Model resource's own ARM Id) - NOT a discoveryRuleId as MS Learn's reference docs state. A Recovery Plan must already exist on the Service Group before the Drill can succeed. drillAssetProperties.resourceGroup MUST be set to an existing, tag-policy-compliant resource group (e.g. 'IRM').

Name of the Azure Health Model created by step1. Default matches step1's naming formula. Used to build the Health Model's own resourceId referenced by the Drill's healthModelMonitoringProperties.healthModelId.
